title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09
source: Recording Info: Beyer M160 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) -> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) -> KORG AudioGate 4 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC (24bit/96k); Recorded By Frank Streeter; Transferred and Mastered By Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Decent recording captures a high‑energy, all‑cylinders performance with highlights like To Lay Me Down and China Cat Sunflower.
ai_review.review: The fan notes that the concert is an “under‑the‑radar gem” with every song played nicely and several favorite selections, especially the dancing‑inducing stretch around the four‑minute mark of China Cat. The show builds a great momentum into a satisfying close with Going Down the Road/Satisfaction and a classic Brokedown Palace encore. No specific recording flaws are mentioned, suggesting an overall acceptable sound.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed positive review (4 stars) praises the musical performance strongly; lack of recording details leads to a modest assumption of good but not exceptional audio quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on soundboard, audience mix, or clarity; reviewers imply the recording is listenable with no major issues noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows smoothly, building energy early (notably around the China Cat segment) and ending with a strong close and beloved encore.
